title: The identifiers of the surfaces frames are handed to
description: Written by the running sketch just after launch, when the display output lives in another process: only when the tool that owns the window started it (MOKUME_VIEWPORT_OWNER is set) and this facet exists. A sketch that finds the facet without that variable opens its own window and leaves this file alone. A reader looks the surfaces up by identifier and takes the one whose mokume.frame attribute is largest (ADR-0032 decision 3). The contents change only when the size changes; this is not written per frame.

schemaVersion.description: The version of this format. How it is raised is ADR-0018 decision 5.

ids.description: The surface identifiers (IOSurfaceGetID). The order is the order they are written in. There is more than one so that a half-written frame is never handed over.

width.description: The surface's width in pixels. The same as the drawing resolution, with no bars included.

height.description: The surface's height in pixels. The same as the drawing resolution, with no bars included.

windowScale.description: How many points of the window one pixel takes (SketchSettings.windowScale). The tool's artwork window opens at width × windowScale by height × windowScale, the size the sketch's own window would open at, and follows it again only when that size changes (#1624). Optional: a reader that does not know it still shows the picture, and a writer that predates it leaves it out, in which case the window keeps its size.
